# edgeos_system_syslog_file (Resource)

An extra log file (`system syslog file <name>`), written to `/var/log/user/<name>`.

Destroying the resource deletes the whole file node; EdgeOS leaves the file itself on disk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Kernel messages (firewall log rules) to /var/log/user/firewall.
resource "edgeos_system_syslog_file" "firewall" {
  name = "firewall"
  facilities = {
    kern = "warning"
  }
  archive_files = 3
  archive_size  = 512
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `facilities` (Map of String) Facilities to log and the lowest level logged for each (`facility <name> level <level>`), such as `{ all = "notice", protocols = "debug" }`. Facilities: `all`, `auth`, `authpriv`, `cron`, `daemon`, `kern`, `lpr`, `mail`, `mark`, `news`, `protocols`, `security`, `syslog`, `user`, `uucp`, `local0`, `local1`, `local2`, `local3`, `local4`, `local5`, `local6`, `local7`. Levels: `emerg`, `alert`, `crit`, `err`, `warning`, `notice`, `info`, `debug`. The resource owns the whole list: facilities that are not in the map are removed.
- `name` (String) File name below `/var/log/user/`, letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`. Changing it creates a new file target.

### Optional

- `archive_files` (Number) Number of rotated log files to keep (`archive files`). Unset leaves it alone.
- `archive_size` (Number) Size in kilobytes at which the log file is rotated (`archive size`). Unset leaves it alone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The file name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_system_syslog_file.firewall
  id = "firewall"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_system_syslog_file.firewall 'firewall'
```
